text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm waiting for my train on
the station
platform...

...And just like that, the time has come
for us to
part ways.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We met for the first time exactly one
year ago.
Each day we spent together is
an irreplaceable
memory to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl looks devastated
while saying
farewell to someone...
except I don't see anyone
else nearby.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm bidding farewell to the seasonal
bento boxes!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Today is the last day they'll be on sale.
The next
time we'll meet won't be until
next year, which
why I must do this!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, shopkeeper! May I have
twelve of
these bentos?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I want to fill my heart and stomach with
enough
food for the months we can't
meet!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I want to fill my heart and stomach with
enough
food for the months we can't
meet!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So what you're trying to say is that if I
wish to
preserve this memory, I should
focus not on how
much I eat, but rather
the heart and quality of my
experience.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have one, then, so I can focus all
my time
and attention talking with it
face-to-face.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Chomp... Thank you simmered meat! Munch... Au revoir, white fish!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This I declare—not a single sesame seed
nor grain
of rice will be left uneaten!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Chomp, munch... Urgh... Don't give up, stomach! This is the last time we'll see these lovely morsels for a while!
